as_of_content:
[[File:Planet landscape.jpg|thumb|300x300px]]
'''New Quintessa''' is the planet in which [[Marissa Faireborn]] of the [[EDC (Earth Defense Command|EDC]] and the [[Autobots]] accidentally crash-land with the Ark. [[Optimus Prime]] orders his small Squad to scout the area and they soon discover that there is a dark presence of which corrupts both Autobots and [[Decepticons]] from their world as from alternative dimensions.

After facing [[Bumblebee (DOTM)|Bumblebee]] from an alternative world, and bringing reinforcements through the Space-Bridge, Optimus handles the Matrix of Leadership to the Commander.

After the [[Story]] progresses, it is also discovered the presence of [[The Quintessons]] and their twisted plots involved in amusement with various [[Bots]] fighting each other to the death (K.O.).
[[Category:Story]]
[[Category:Gameplay]]
